coverage: each original requirement exactly once; compare labels independently; wrong-direction can be covered, actual missing components partial/missing; report confusion and full planned coverage
reference_units: 58 frozen semantic units, not mechanical carriers; no edits after results
equivalent_split_merge: same scoped meaning may jointly align; reference once only; shared prediction index disclosed, not independent repeated judgments
mixed_or_partial: mixed support labels inside a compound reference or partial meaning equivalence => unaligned; no favored-subclause selection, collapse or scope completion from rationale
conflict: conflicting duplicate predictions separate; do not cherry-pick
alignment_method: AI-assisted semantic review of final valid predictions and original answer references; program carrier overlap supports location only, not semantic equivalence; no keyword similarity gate
E: final valid, fully semantically aligned reference units without unresolved conflict
F: E: predicted supported and reference in insufficient_evidence/contradicted/not_assessable
false_rejection: E: reference supported and predicted non-support; report count and fraction over E supported references, split predicted labels
unaligned: reduces evaluable coverage, not automatically incorrect
failures_unexecuted: all planned samples/requirements/reference units enumerated; no extrapolation from completed prefix
reasons: each requirement/unit/judgment/overall reason inspected for specific scope, empty/general text, label conflict, unsupported inference; structural nonempty not semantic guarantee
human_status: user confirms frozen references, post-prediction AI alignment/reason judgments remain suggestions pending user review; not expert gold
